name: hotkey-builder
description: Find free keys and build working shortcuts, macros and text-injection hotkeys on Ubuntu: probe keyboards and USB IDs, audit every existing binding (KDE, GNOME, input-remapper, keyd, hwdb), suggest non-conflicting keys, check and install injectors (ydotool) and interceptors (input-remapper), bind by the route that works on X11 or Wayland, verify, and keep a per-machine reference.
